fullPassage: Curiosity is the essence of life. Animals including humans cannot live without knowing what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival: where to find food, how to avoid predators, where to find mates, etc. However, the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge that reaches far beyond our personal needs. We look around us and we wonder. We wonder about our surroundings and about what we observe both near and far and we want to understand it all. Indeed, we fear the unknown. This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.

questions.passage: Curiosity is the essence of life. Animals including humans cannot live without knowing what is useful to them and what is needed for their survival: where to find food, how to avoid predators, where to find mates, etc. However, the human species differs from other animals because <u>we</u> thirst for knowledge that reaches far beyond our personal needs. We look around us and we wonder. We wonder about our surroundings and about what we observe both near and far and we want to understand it all. Indeed, we fear the unknown. This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>we</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'we': S3에서 'the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge' — we는 인간 종을 지칭.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 인간 종: S3의 'the human species'가 바로 앞 선행사. we = 인간 종
❌ ② 다른 동물들: S3에서 인간과 대비되는 존재 (we가 지칭하는 대상 아님)
❌ ③ 포식자: S2에서 회피 대상으로 언급, we와 무관
❌ ④ 연구자들: 지문에 등장하지 않음
det.tip: S3: 'the human species differs from other animals because we thirst for knowledge' → we = the human species(인간 종).

S7: This sense of wonder and desire for understanding not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization
빈칸: not only makes us human, but is also one of the foundation stones of civilization (15단어)
단어 확인: not(1) only(2) makes(3) us(4) human(5) but(6) is(7) also(8) one(9) of(10) the(11) foundation(12) stones(13) of(14) civilization(15) ✅

det.tip: S7: not only A but also B 구조. 'of'가 두 번(one of the + of civilization) 사용됨에 주의.
